remarks: Look no further for the ultimate sun-soaked oasis with an expansive open concept, just steps away from all that SONO has to offer. As you step into the main level, you'll be greeted by an abundance of natural light that floods the open concept living space. The spacious living area seamlessly flows into the dining area and kitchen, creating the perfect environment for entertaining guests or simply relaxing in style. A convenient half bathroom on this level adds to the overall convenience of the space. In the lower level you'll find the spacious bedroom suite with a full bathroom. One of the standout features of this condo is the secondary entrance/exit located on the lower level. This unique feature not only enhances privacy but also provides easy access to the storage room, gym, bike storage and parking garage. Convenience and functionality are truly at the forefront of this home's design. Situated in the heart of SONO, this condo offers unbeatable walkability to a plethora of amenities. Maritime Aquarium, Oyster Park, and the nearby Metro North station, providing swift access to Norwalk's beautiful beaches and major highways. Enjoy strolls to nearby restaurants, bars, the train station, shopping mall, and beautiful parks. Experience the vibrant urban lifestyle that SONO is known for, all right at your doorstep. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity to rent a two-level 1-bedroom condo in one of SONO's most sought-after locations. See it today!
